annotations.title: Add, change or delete a contact field

description: Writes the workspace’s contact fields: the keys a contact’s attributes can hold. action create adds one (key, label, type text, number, date, boolean or choice, choices for a choice field, required). action update (id) changes a field’s label, type, choices or required; its key stays. action delete (id) removes the field and every contact’s value for it. Creating, changing and deleting are for owners and admins. Each delete needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it deletes.

choices.description: A choice field's options, 1 to 100 of them, each once; none otherwise.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.
